name: Marinna Frostbeard
title: Silver Tongue of Frostgate
description: A sturdy dwarf with braided silver hair, steely blue eyes, and a scar across her left cheek. Renowned for her sharp negotiating skills and boisterous laugh echoing through the Frostgate bazaar.

notable_events.event: Broached peace talks with the Mountain Orcs at the Stonefall Summit
Exposed the Iron Veil smuggling ring in the Frostgate tunnels

personality_traits: Fond of strong ale and storytelling

inventory.name: Fine Merchant Scales
inventory.description: A precision set of brass scales, used to weigh jewels and precious metals.

inventory.name: Frostbeard Signet Ring
inventory.description: A heavy iron ring engraved with the Frostbeard clan crest, used to seal trade agreements.
